en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's go in the freezer
Let's have some tea
Let's try fasting

Are you trying to learn one of 
my spells? You are, aren't you?

You wanna learn how to go into the 
freezer and come out of the cabinet?
Let's see...

I'll decide if I want to teach you after
seeing how good your magic is.

But you've got ambition, wanting to 
learn such an advanced spell first.
Well, that's not a bad idea.

If we have sweets too, I can convert 
them to mana, the source of magic.

It seems like you're starting to 
understand how magic works.

Nyeh? I think you're misunderstanding 
how to be a mage...

It's true you need discipline in 
order to learn magic.

But that doesn't mean you need 
to make yourself suffer.

I thought you had potential, 
but I guess I was wrong...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
